name: Power Generation & Grid Node
representative_system: Composite — a generic thermal/hydro generation plant and grid substation, not a named facility

cost.display: Not a procured unit — infrastructure whose value is measured in grid capacity and repair cost after a strike, not a purchase price

key_facts.label: Why it matters
key_facts.value: One node can cascade outages across a wide grid area

key_facts.label: Defended by
key_facts.value: Layered air defense (SAM, gun-CUAS, MANPADS) rather than any organic defense

key_facts.label: Repair tempo
key_facts.value: Repeated strikes outpace repair during sustained campaigns

short_role: Representative strategic-rear infrastructure target — power generation and grid nodes, alongside bridges, fuel depots and warehousing at similar depth.
characteristics: A single generation or transformer node failure can cascade into outages well beyond the immediate facility
Has no offensive capability of its own — its only 'connection' to the fight is being defended and repaired
Sits at strategic-rear depth precisely because that is the band deep-strike systems (cruise missiles, one-way-attack drones) are built to reach
employment_notes: This node exists on the map to represent the category the master brief calls out explicitly — strategic/operational/tactical targets at varying depth (power plants, logistics hubs, bridges, warehousing) — rather than one named facility. It sits inside the layered air-defense picture (Patriot, IADS network) as something those systems exist partly to protect.
contrast_vs_traditional: Strategic infrastructure has always been a wartime target; what changed is the volume and cost asymmetry of what can now reach it. A saturation raid of cheap one-way-attack drones forces exactly the same expensive interceptor-per-shot economics discussed elsewhere in this doctrine set, this time defending fixed civilian-facing infrastructure rather than a military position.

sources.label: Composite/illustrative — no single named facility; category per master prompt asset list
